correctness.rationale: For noncomplete K_{n1,...,nr}, ordinary zero forcing requires at least N-2 seeds: with >=3 white vertices a first force either cannot occur or leaves >=2 whites of one part, after which no force is possible. A minimum complement must consist of vertices in distinct parts. For omitted x in part i,y in j, synchronous round-one weights are (nj-1)alpha and (ni-1)alpha; the only possible second round adds (N-nj-1)alpha+(nj-1)alpha^2 to y after x fills. Thus the size-N-2 criterion is beta<=max_{s>=2} min((s-1)alpha,(N-s-1)alpha+(s-1)alpha^2); N-1 succeeds iff beta<=Delta alpha. All-singletons K_N has N-1/N transition at (N-1)alpha. This is a symbolic proof for positive alpha,beta<=1, not an inference from finite tests; independent exact-rational direct subset testing of 592 small graph/parameter instances agreed. Boundaries beta=equality are included by >= threshold condition.
